rateOfFireOutliers: M87A1 site 94.73654 is reproduced by primary RateOfFire 1799.999 plus BoltActionTime/Speed/Delay, not raw RateOfFire alone.

reloadProposal: Use the current normalized source formulas: tacRld = ReloadInfoArray[0].ReloadTimeBulletsLeft / ReloadSpeed for 60 weapons; M87A1, M1014 and DB-12 equal (ReloadTimeBulletsLeft + ReloadDelay + PostReloadDelay) / ReloadSpeed. All 60 non-null emptyRld values equal selected ReloadTimeBulletsLeft / ReloadSpeed (entry [1] for 58 weapons and entry [0] for one-entry M44 and TRR8). Keep M87A1, M1014 and DB-12 emptyRld unavailable (null). These are source/site numeric matches; only four default-loadout auto-reload captures test runtime timing. Do not infer ammo-commit or manual/MP behavior for other weapons.
